summary: No blocking integrity defect found in the completed frozen-G local/whole packet. Independent recount verifies native formal bbs 5588/4447 and 5589/4456, whole-local +1/+9, with 26 strict repairs and 17 damages. Both remain below recorded original G5615/4495 and target5615/4754. One-seed development scope, non-bitwise outputs, inactive legacy diagnostics and bounded source/record reconstruction require qualifiers.
model_attribution: Requested/configured native Codex agent route supplied by caller; backend SKU not independently attested.
trace_handling: Caller owns native agent request/response trace. This reviewer is restricted to analysis outputs and does not claim to have written the caller's .aris trace.

reviewer_context.initialization_files: SOUL.md, USER.md and the required current/previous daily-memory files. Main-session MEMORY.md was not read.

execution_scope.CPU_box_reconstruction: Python float64 IoU from every saved selected final/coarse center-size box and saved dataset root_box, in both bbs and bbf, all six sets.

gt_provenance.label: A
gt_provenance.details: Dataset annotation target_id determines scan box and point-membership masks. Model inputs exclude target geometry/identity; GroupFree detections used with butd_gt/butd_cls false. GT-qualified semantic replacement is training-only and frozen in this head-only control. Native predicted-Mask consistency targets are not benchmark GT.

score_normalization.label: B
score_normalization.details: Box/Mask intersection-over-union and true row-count denominators are used; no self-max/min performance normalization. Native bbs token score and bbf temperature0.07 contrastive score select the same query index for final box/coarse box/Mask within a saved row. Prediction-weighted spatial features are not metric denominators.

result_existence.label: C
result_existence.details: All84 listed inputs exist and were read. All63 intake payloads are SHA/length exact. Closed controller and four completed stages agree with logs/receipts. Both training logs have3723 updates over29778 unique row IDs in identical order. All metric and formal-refinement summary values checked by the independent recount agree. Historical original-G rows and proposed next-experiment executions are not certified.

dead_code.label: D
dead_code.details: Current claimed REC/Mask paths are called and recorded. Inherited calculate_diou_3d has zero active calls; old whole_range_loss_routes and native_mask_loss_routes are not invoked. verify_native_replacement requires update=False, while both runner call sites pass True. None is acceptable evidence of a newly executed check; no current reported metric depends on them.

scope.label: E
scope.details: Two conditions, seed2027, one29778-row pass and3723 updates per arm from the same original G. Initial/terminal6887 covers106 scenes/1479 targets; formal9508 covers141 scenes/2068 targets. Holdout is declared pretrained-seen and formal is development validation. Initial query/box/Mask values differ across processes, with one later within-arm whole Mask-IoU difference. Parameters/buffers fixed by source/runtime assertion does not imply exact outputs. No stable gain, causal ranking-only effect or new Nr3D/Sr3D/V99 performance is established.

eval_type.label: F
eval_type.details: REC and Mask are real_gt; selected coarse/final comparison is real_gt geometry diagnosis. Full256/top-k coverage uses real GT as an offline oracle, not deployed accuracy or model-generated GT. No human/simulation/synthetic-reference benchmark claim is accepted.

nonblocking_issues.required_qualifier: Do not claim independent model/optimizer/ranking replay or raw-Mask/all-candidate reconstruction.

nonblocking_issues.required_qualifier: Preservation/no-archive statements must remain source/record bounded, not a fresh filesystem proof.

limitations: Raw original dataset, manifests/split file dependencies and transitive imported code not listed in the request were not reloaded or recursively audited.
Native-source copies were bound to recorded current imports by byte identity, not a new network retrieval or authenticity check of an upstream release.

Actual optimizer calls and original-G persistent-state equality are supported by runner source, closed execution records and receipt assertions; checkpoint/optimizer tensors were not read or replayed.
imports.json/load.json are last rewritten by formal mode; fresh_optimizer in load.json alone is not an optimizer-state witness. Actual train code constructs fresh AdamW.

All fit row identities/order were independently compared; per-update augmented tensors are not saved for independent byte comparison. Fit-scene count456 is from source/log assertion, while evaluated-scene counts are reconstructed.
Historical original-G evaluation rows and full pretraining provenance were not supplied. The declared pretrained-seen/dev caveats are preserved.
No scientific significance test across seeds or independent repeat was performed.
GT oracle coverage does not certify physical instance identity or achievable deployed scorer accuracy.
No independent active server, V99 checkpoint chain, current resource state or other-directory archive inventory was performed.
Workspace-mandated session identity/daily-memory reads occurred during fresh-task initialization and were not used as result evidence.
